messages.text: Harlo B1 price in EU after payment still needs to pay taxes or are they included?

Nothing more to pay. The Harlo B1 is $99 USD, and for Portugal it ships from our Netherlands warehouse, so import VAT is already in the price. There are no duties or customs charges when it arrives.

Shipping is the only thing added. Checkout works it out from your address and shows it before you pay.

Here's the link: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/harlo-b1

Are you thinking of the B1 as a first miner, or getting it alongside the Magic M. 40T you asked about last time?
Going for the B1 as the first miner.

I've put the B1 in a cart for you, $99, with your email already filled in: (order link hidden)

Add your Portuguese address there and you'll see the shipping cost before you pay. The plug is matched to your address.

To set it up you need 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. A 5 GHz-only network won't work. Everything else comes in the box, including the 40W USB-C power adapter and a stand. It uses about 22W in Normal mode, so it costs very little to run.
